description: THE HERO SPECIMEN. Standing observed valid at t=40 with a horizon expiring t=50; the spend is attempted at t=51 -- one second past the horizon. Standing was true when checked and void when spent. Naive auth says yes (the credential was valid); custody says no (it lapsed in the gap). The standing-spendability gate refuses BEFORE any capacity is spent (effect=0), and the receipt carries both clocks and the gap. Columbo: 'the observation was eleven seconds stale, sir, and the spend happened one second past the horizon.'
